text: The initiative aims to enhance food security and resilience in Papua New Guinea by adapting small-scale agriculture to withstand climate risks. It focuses on climate-proofing production systems, reducing post-harvest losses, and building capacity among communities and institutions. The project is aligned with national strategies and the Adaptation Fund's environmental and social safeguards, with technical support from the Pacific Community.

metadata.solution_name: Adaptation of Small-Scale Agriculture for improved food security of resilient communities in Papua New Guinea
